summary: @servicetitan/data-query preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun v1.3.13 binary for the host platform from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and uses that freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute an adjacent 727KB file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated single-line bundle (rotating string array via WV8StW, hex-obfuscated identifiers, large rotated char-code table n7gIxM, multiple `with` blocks to defeat strict-mode deobfuscators) with no relation to the package's advertised Kendo/OData data-query purpose. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js sit at the tarball root and are not listed in the package.json `files` field (declared as ["dist","src"]), so they are outside the author's declared publish surface. The alternate-runtime dispatch keeps the executed payload out of reach of Node-based install-time inspection; it runs under the installing user's privileges on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
